journey.name: usdt receive swipe tabs
journey.description:
On the Receive sheet, swiping sideways over the QR changes tabs on every tab, USDT included. With USDT selected, a swipe to the right over its QR selects the tab before it (Spending) and does not copy the address; a swipe to the left does nothing, since USDT is the last tab. A single tap on the USDT QR still copies the address and shows the "copied" tooltip.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with USDT enabled (introductory sheet or Settings, General, Payments), no CJIT invoice pending, start on the wallet home screen. The USDT address loads without funding; wait for the QR before swiping.
The copy shows as a tooltip over the QR for about two seconds, so a check for "no copy" reads a screenshot taken right after the swipe. Swipe with `adb shell input swipe` across the middle of the QR, about 60% of its width, in 300 ms.

actions.action: Tap the USDT tab (testTag "Tab-usdt") and wait until the USDT QR is visible
Swipe right across the QR and take a screenshot right away
Verify the Spending tab (testTag "Tab-spending") is selected, the Lightning receive content or the Spending setup is shown, and the screenshot shows no "copied" tooltip
Swipe left across the QR and verify the USDT tab is selected and its QR is visible
Swipe left across the USDT QR and take a screenshot right away; verify the USDT tab stays selected and the screenshot shows no "copied" tooltip
Tap the USDT QR once and verify the "copied" tooltip appears
